**Comparing the geographic and numeric distributions of Daymet and gridMET minimum and maximum daily temperature in Chicago (by 2020 census tract centroid)** **on July 13, 1995. This represents the hottest day of the 1995 Chicago heatwave** **(deadliest weather event in Chicago history).**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Loading the necessary packages
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(sf)
library(gtsummary)
library(cowplot)

# Importing the Daymet and gridMET temperature data
centroids_daymet_gridmet <- read_csv("centroids_daymet_gridmet.csv")
```

**Map of Chicago 2020 census tract boundaries and centroids.**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Loading Chicago 2020 census tract boundaries shapefile
census_tracts <- st_read(dsn = "Boundaries - Census Tracts - 2020_20261023/geo_export_97d0a9fa-91fb-41d0-b1ff-52a689dee70a.shp", quiet = TRUE)

# Dropping unneeded variables
census_tracts <- census_tracts %>%
  select(-c(tract_fips, tract_ce, commarea, commarea_n, community_))

# Extracting the centroid of each Chicago census tract
centroids <- st_centroid(census_tracts)
centroids <- st_transform(centroids, crs = st_crs(census_tracts)$proj4string)

# Creating map
tm_shape(census_tracts) +
  tm_polygons() +
  tm_scalebar(position = c(0.2, 0.1)) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE, inner.margins = c(0.05, 0.1, 0, 0)) +
  tm_shape(centroids) +
  tm_dots(fill = "red", size = 0.15) +
  tm_credits("Chicago, Illinois 2020 census tracts and centroids; N = 789", position = c("RIGHT", "BOTTOM"))
```

**Maps by 2020 census tract (centroid) of Daymet and gridMET minimum and maximum daily temperature in Chicago on July 13, 1995.**

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| message: false
# Merging the temperature estimates with the census tract shapefile
census_tracts$tract_full <- as.numeric(census_tracts$tract_full)
census_tracts_temperature <- inner_join(census_tracts, centroids_daymet_gridmet, by = "tract_full")

# Creating Daymet maximum temperature map
map_daymet_tmax <- tm_shape(census_tracts_temperature) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "tmax_daymet", fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(values = "brewer.reds", breaks = seq(37.5, 40.0, by = 0.25), label.format = tm_label_format(digits = 2)), fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Daymet Maximum\nTemperature (Celsius)", reverse = TRUE, title.size = 1.1, text.size = 1)) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c(0.2, 0.05), text.size = 0.7) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE, inner.margins = c(0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02))

# Creating gridMET maximum temperature map
map_gridmet_tmax <- tm_shape(census_tracts_temperature) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "tmax_gridmet", fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(values = "brewer.reds", breaks = seq(37.5, 40.0, by = 0.25), label.format = tm_label_format(digits = 2)), fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "gridMET Maximum\nTemperature (Celsius)", reverse = TRUE, title.size = 1.1, text.size = 1)) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c(0.2, 0.05), text.size = 0.7) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE, inner.margins = c(0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02))

# Creating Daymet minimum temperature map
map_daymet_tmin <- tm_shape(census_tracts_temperature) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "tmin_daymet", fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(values = "brewer.reds", breaks = seq(23.2, 25.7, by = 0.25), label.format = tm_label_format(digits = 2)), fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Daymet Minimum\nTemperature (Celsius)", reverse = TRUE, title.size = 1.1, text.size = 1)) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c(0.2, 0.05), text.size = 0.7) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE, inner.margins = c(0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02))

# Creating gridMET minimum temperature map
map_gridmet_tmin <- tm_shape(census_tracts_temperature) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "tmin_gridmet", fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(values = "brewer.reds", breaks = seq(23.2, 25.7, by = 0.25), label.format = tm_label_format(digits = 2)), fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "gridMET Minimum\nTemperature (Celsius)", reverse = TRUE, title.size = 1.1, text.size = 1)) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c(0.2, 0.05), text.size = 0.7) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE, inner.margins = c(0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02))

# Map panel
tmap_save(map_daymet_tmax, "map_daymet_tmax.png", width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
tmap_save(map_gridmet_tmax, "map_gridmet_tmax.png", width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
tmap_save(map_daymet_tmin, "map_daymet_tmin.png", width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
tmap_save(map_gridmet_tmin, "map_gridmet_tmin.png", width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
panel_daymet_tmax <- ggdraw() + draw_image("map_daymet_tmax.png")
panel_gridmet_tmax <- ggdraw() + draw_image("map_gridmet_tmax.png")
panel_daymet_tmin <- ggdraw() + draw_image("map_daymet_tmin.png")
panel_gridmet_tmin <- ggdraw() + draw_image("map_gridmet_tmin.png")
maps_grid <- plot_grid(panel_daymet_tmax, panel_gridmet_tmax, panel_daymet_tmin, panel_gridmet_tmin, nrow = 2, ncol = 2, rel_heights = c(1, 1), align = "hv")
caption <- ggdraw() + draw_label("Chicago, Illinois (by 2020 census tract centroid); 13 July 1995; N = 789", x = 0.99, y = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 12)
map_daymet_gridmet <- plot_grid(maps_grid, caption, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.06))
ggsave("map_daymet_gridmet.png", map_daymet_gridmet, width = 14, height = 11, units = "in", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

**Summary statistics of Daymet and gridMET minimum and maximum daily temperatures in Chicago on July 13, 1995 (by 2020 census tract centroid).**

```{r}
#| echo: false
summary_data_daymet <- centroids_daymet_gridmet %>%
  select(tmax_daymet, tmin_daymet) %>%
  rename(tmax = tmax_daymet,
         tmin = tmin_daymet) %>%
  mutate(Data = "Daymet")
summary_data_gridmet <- centroids_daymet_gridmet %>%
  select(tmax_gridmet, tmin_gridmet) %>%
  rename(tmax = tmax_gridmet,
         tmin = tmin_gridmet) %>%
  mutate(Data = "gridMET")
summary_data <- rbind(summary_data_daymet, summary_data_gridmet)
summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(Data = fct_relevel(Data, "Daymet", "gridMET"))
rm(summary_data_daymet, summary_data_gridmet)

summary_data %>%
  tbl_summary(by = Data, statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "({min}, {max}); {mean} ({sd}); {median} ({p25}-{p75})"))
```
